items.title: DISABLE_PROMPT_CACHING
items.when: From code: When truthy, the check that decides whether a request gets prompt-cache markers returns false for every model. It is checked before the per-model variables, so it overrides them. That check applies whenever a caller does not pass its own caching flag. No caller in this build passes a literal true; several internal side requests pass a literal false, and a few forward a value that this reference does not trace. It also sets the workflow same-prefix stagger wait to 0. When it or the HAIKU, OPUS, SONNET or FABLE variable is truthy, a warning notice reads "Prompt caching off ({{DISABLED_CACHE_VARS}}), requests will be slower and cost more · unset it to re-enable". {{DISABLED_CACHE_VARS}} is the set variables from that list of five, joined with ", ".

details.read_as_note: true when the value, trimmed and lowercased, is 1, true, yes or on; anything else is false
details.description: When truthy, the check that decides whether a request gets prompt-cache markers returns false for every model. It is checked before the per-model variables, so it overrides them. That check applies whenever a caller does not pass its own caching flag. No caller in this build passes a literal true; several internal side requests pass a literal false, and a few forward a value that this reference does not trace. It also sets the workflow same-prefix stagger wait to 0. When it or the HAIKU, OPUS, SONNET or FABLE variable is truthy, a warning notice reads "Prompt caching off ({{DISABLED_CACHE_VARS}}), requests will be slower and cost more · unset it to re-enable". {{DISABLED_CACHE_VARS}} is the set variables from that list of five, joined with ", ".
details.docs_summary: Set to `1` to disable prompt caching for all models (takes precedence over per-model settings)
